shorts.hook: The cassowary can't fly, but its tiny wings hide something worse.
shorts.title: The Cassowary Can't Fly but Still Has a Claw on Its Wing
shorts.outro: Its feet are even worse. The full video is linked below.
shorts.end_card: WHAT'S ON THE FEET? TAP BELOW
shorts.description: The flightless cassowary's tiny wing hides four bare black quills and a curved claw.

shorts.hook: Campers saw a fin heading for the beach. It wasn't a shark.
shorts.title: Campers Saw a Fin Coming Ashore. It Was a Cassowary.
shorts.outro: Running away doesn't work either. The full video is linked below.
shorts.end_card: WHERE CAN DOUG HIDE? TAP BELOW
shorts.description: In 2023, campers at Bingil Bay in Queensland watched a young cassowary swim in from the sea and walk up the beach.

shorts.hook: This bird's dagger claw grows on a very famous toe.
shorts.title: The Cassowary's Dagger Claw Is on the Raptor's Killing Toe
shorts.outro: Then Doug tested it himself. The full video is linked below.
shorts.description: The cassowary's dagger claw grows on digit two, the same toe that carried the raptor dinosaurs' famous killing claw.
